# Flutter Kickstart

> Flutter Kickstart creates a production-ready Flutter app from a few quick setup questions: Very Good CLI flavors (development/staging/production), feature-first clean architecture, Bloc or Riverpod, an AppApiClient network layer (viva_network_kit or plain Dio) with typed AppFailure errors, go_router, theming, l10n, crash reporting, tests (~95% coverage), optional GitHub Actions + Fastlane CI/CD, and an AI-agent layer (AGENTS.md + skills) for Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, Antigravity, Codex, Gemini CLI and Copilot. The generator verifies the app with flutter analyze and flutter test before reporting success.

Install: `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/alamin-karno/flutter-kickstart/main/install.sh | bash`, then `fks create`.

## Guide
- [Introduction](https://alamin-karno.github.io/flutter-kickstart/guide/introduction): what it is and who it is for
- [Installation](https://alamin-karno.github.io/flutter-kickstart/guide/installation): one-line installers, Claude Code plugin, skill folders per agent
- [Quick start](https://alamin-karno.github.io/flutter-kickstart/guide/quick-start): create, run and grow an app
- [Setup questions](https://alamin-karno.github.io/flutter-kickstart/guide/setup-questions): every question, flag and default
- [Using it with AI agents](https://alamin-karno.github.io/flutter-kickstart/guide/ai-agents): plain-language prompts and what the agent does
- [Adding features](https://alamin-karno.github.io/flutter-kickstart/guide/adding-features): fks add-feature / add_feature.py
- [Figma to Flutter](https://alamin-karno.github.io/flutter-kickstart/guide/figma-to-flutter): design-to-code skill
